evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in medical question answering and clinical reasoning, yet their improvement remains constrained by static parametric knowledge and costly expert supervision.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Across all settings, MedZERO consistently outperforms the underlying base models and prior self-evolving baselines, achieving up to 13.7 average accuracy-point gains over the next-best self-evolving baseline.
